governing_rule: Source type is genre only, not evidentiary strength and not institutional authority. Those are separate concepts (see README section 10). A reputable publisher is not automatically an institutional authority.

primary_record.definition: The original document, transcript, filing, or dataset itself.
primary_record.does_not_include: Does not include a summary, reproduction, commentary, or interpretation of that record.

archival_reproduction.definition: A faithful copy, transcript, or recording of a primary record hosted by an archive or research institution.
archival_reproduction.does_not_include: Does not include the original record itself, a summary, commentary, or an interpretation of that record.

official_publication.definition: Published by the body that has authority over the subject matter.
official_publication.does_not_include: Does not include material merely hosted by a reputable or official publisher that lacks authority over the subject matter.

regulation_or_rule.definition: Binding rule, statute, or regulation text.
regulation_or_rule.does_not_include: Does not include nonbinding guidance, commentary, or a summary of a rule.

standards_body.definition: A published standard from a recognised standards organisation.
standards_body.does_not_include: Does not include informal guidance or a standard created by a vendor or this project.

peer_reviewed.definition: Research that went through peer review.
peer_reviewed.does_not_include: Does not include preprints, working papers, or research summaries that were not themselves peer reviewed.

preprint.does_not_include: Does not include research published after completing peer review.

textbook.does_not_include: Does not include journal research, practitioner writing, or tertiary encyclopedias.

practitioner_publication.does_not_include: Does not include binding rules, peer-reviewed research, or vendor product documentation.

vendor_documentation.definition: Product or service documentation from its vendor.
vendor_documentation.does_not_include: Does not include independent analysis, journalism, or unofficial community documentation.

news_or_magazine.definition: Journalism or magazine writing, including business magazines.
news_or_magazine.does_not_include: Does not include a primary record merely quoted or linked by the article.

encyclopedia.does_not_include: Does not include primary records, textbooks, or original research cited by the reference work.

local_synthesis.definition: This project's own inference, which inherits no authority from its inputs.
local_synthesis.does_not_include: Does not include any external source, even when this project quotes or summarizes it.

cited_but_unlinked.definition: A real source with no confirmable public locator.
cited_but_unlinked.does_not_include: Does not include a source with a confirmed public locator or a source whose existence is unverified.
